Tutorial plateau and northern town.

Rough tutorial terrain · two elevated tiers · no ramps or climb links

Northwest — Tutorial 4Northeast — Tutorial 3Southwest — Tutorial 2Southeast · start — Tutorial 1Northern town — Tutorial 5

In the editor, choose altitude 3 to show both tiers, then Overview. Altitudes 1 and 2 expose the lower layers.

Gold dots mark the cliff seams 24 tiles from the outside edges. The irregular summit has a lower shelf varying from 0–2 tiles wide. Tutorial 4 extends north between the one-third and two-thirds marks.

The northwest travel marker is at the northern town approach. Cliff faces remain non-climbable. Sector 5 now receives the plateau 24 tiles deep from its southern edge. Its town terrain is editable; buildings, the actual descent, encounters and campaign transitions are still to be authored.
